text: You are the grandfather. Some years later you write a letter to Natalia, for a special birthday,
to remind her of your shared experience.
Examiner’s
Write the letter to your granddaughter.
In your letter you should include:
• the atmosphere of the city that night
• your reasons for taking your granddaughter out that night
• your thoughts and feelings now as you look back on the experience.
Base your letter on what you have read in Passage A. Address all three bullet points.
Be careful to use your own words.
Begin your letter, ‘Dear Natalia, I wonder if you remember…’.
Write between 1½ and 2 sides, allowing for the size of your handwriting.
Up to 15 marks are available for the content of your answer, and up to 5 marks for the
quality of your writing.
